text: Primary source: CNBC Bank of America's disclosure puts a workforce and cost figure on the security work that follows AI-driven vulnerability discovery. The reported spending combines Mythos remediation with anti-money-laundering work, so it cannot be read as the model's standalone price tag. Bank of America added 1,000 contractors in the second quarter to help patch software vulnerabilities surfaced by advanced AI models, including Anthropic's Mythos , CEO Brian Moynihan told CNBC .…
